subject: Post-demo action grid: SDK + streaming callflow (MAP draft)
messages:
From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
To: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@averyhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-11T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Post-demo action grid: SDK + streaming callflow (MAP draft)

Tom — thanks again for taking the demo earlier. Short recap and proposed next steps to shape the MAP milestone for Integration Build (SDK + streaming + tool-calls + structured outputs). Attaching the quick notes from today's call.

Recap (high level):
- Objective: POC to validate SDK integration, streaming responses, and basic tool-calling for clinical lookup workflows.
- Success criteria: <100ms median token latency in dev env, end-to-end call invocation working in sandbox, and structured JSON outputs for ingestion into Avery EHR adapter.
- Constraints: customer requires VPC peering + KMS-managed keys; must pass initial security questionnaire before VPC peering.

Proposed Integration Build milestones (draft):
1) Integration kickoff & architecture sign-off — owner: Avery (Sanjay) / Redwood PM — target: 2026-05-20
2) SDK integration (Java + Python) — owner: Redwood eng (Karthik) — target: 2026-06-10
3) Streaming + continuous KV cache check — owner: Redwood eng — target: 2026-06-18
4) Tool-calling & webhook flow (clinical lookups) — owner: Avery eng / Redwood eng — target: 2026-06-25
5) Structured outputs mapping (JSON schema & validation) — owner: Avery PM + Redwood PM — target: 2026-06-28
6) Security review & VPC peering — owner: Avery Sec (Emily) / Redwood Sec — dependency: security questionnaire completion — target: 2026-06-30
7) UAT & performance runbook — owner: Avery QA + Redwood SRE — target close: 2026-07-08

Asks for you: please confirm the Avery point people for each milestone and whether the dates look achievable. Also confirm any additional dependencies (e.g., procurement for networking, account limits).

Next step I propose: quick 30-minute sync on Wed 2026-05-13 to lock owners and finalize the MAP sheet.

Attachments: postcall_notes_avery_v1.pdf

Best,
Dev Patel
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
dev.patel@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0192

Dev — appreciate the thorough recap. Quick notes from our side:
- We can own the architecture sign-off (Sanjay) and tool-calling work (Sanjay + integration eng).
- Security lead is Emily Park; she'll need the questionnaire and network diagram to start KMS/VPC conversations.
- Preferable target close: mid-late week of 2026-07-05 — our fiscal schedule favors that week.

Dependency additions:
- We need to confirm whether Redwood can support streaming token-level callbacks tied to our request IDs (for traceability).
- For KV cache behavior, please confirm eviction policy and whether Redwood exposes metrics for cache hits by request type.

I've attached our initial network_requirements_v1.pdf with port and outbound IP expectations. Sanjay and I are available for the Wed 05/13 sync.

On the owners you listed, Sanjay will be the engineering owner and Emily will be security owner. I'll add their names in the HubSpot deal.

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-11T18:05:00-07:00
Subject: MAP draft & integration checklist (first pass)

Thanks — I uploaded a first-pass MAP spreadsheet and a concise SDK integration checklist. Documents attached: MAP_DRAFT_AveryHealth_v1.xlsx, sdk_integration_checklist.md.

A few clarifications from product/solutions lens:
- SDK support: we will provide official Java and Python SDKs plus a lightweight Node example. Karthik will be the engineering liaison for any API surface questions.
- Streaming semantics: Redwood supports server-sent streaming with token deltas and optional per-token metadata; we can add request-scoped trace IDs for Avery.
- Tool-calls: Redwood can host a webhook proxy or you can call our tool-calling endpoint directly from your infra. We recommend starting with webhook proxy for observability and rollback safety.
- Structured outputs: propose a small JSON schema that maps the model outputs to your EHR adapter fields. I put a starter schema in the spreadsheet (tab: structured_mapping).

Owner suggestions (internal):
- PM: Marissa Cole (Redwood) — coordinate MAP and acceptance criteria
- Sales lead: Dev Patel (Redwood) — commercial/contract coordination
- SDK eng liaison: Karthik Iyer (Redwood) — API and examples
- Onboarding / docs: Monica Patel (Redwood) — playbooks and runbooks

Can the Avery team confirm their owners in the spreadsheet and mark any items that are blockers so we can sequence work.

Marissa Cole
Senior Product Manager, Integrations
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

All — quick update after internal sync this morning. I've updated the MAP_DRAFT sheet with preliminary assignees and dependencies. High level changes: 
- Moved Streaming + KV cache to run in parallel with SDK integration to shorten timeline; Redwood SRE will own the perf runbook and provide baseline metrics.
- Added dependency: Avery to provide a service account AWS ID for peering and a contact for KMS key policy review (Emily).
- Added a checkpoint: security questionnaire completion required before we schedule VPC peering (target: 2026-06-22).

I put two links in the MAP: hubspot deal and drive folder for artifacts (see linked resources). Please confirm the following by EOD Tue 2026-05-13 so we can lock the kickoff: 
1) Avery owners confirmed in the MAP sheet (engineering, security, QA)
2) Agreement on target close (we proposed 2026-07-08; Tom mentioned mid-week 07/05 — please pick one)
3) Confirm whether Avery wants Redwood to host webhook proxy in your sandbox or you prefer to host directly.

Proposed 30-minute sync Wed 2026-05-13 at 10:00am PT (I sent a calendar hold).

Attachments in MAP folder: MAP_DRAFT_AveryHealth_v1.xlsx, sdk_integration_checklist.md

Thanks,
Dev
